configurations.name: RiverMind: Run iOS 27 Simulator (Recommended)
configurations.command: export DEVELOPER_DIR="/Applications/Xcode-beta.app/Contents/Developer" && source "${env:HOME}/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use --silent && pnpm exec expo run:ios --device "RiverMind iPhone 17 Pro (iOS 27)"

configurations.name: RiverMind: Run iOS 18.5 Simulator (Compatibility)
configurations.command: export DEVELOPER_DIR="/Applications/Xcode-beta.app/Contents/Developer" && source "${env:HOME}/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use --silent && pnpm exec expo run:ios --device "RiverMind iPhone 16 Pro (iOS 18.5)"

configurations.name: RiverMind: Choose Simulator or Device
configurations.command: export DEVELOPER_DIR="/Applications/Xcode-beta.app/Contents/Developer" && source "${env:HOME}/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use --silent && pnpm exec expo run:ios --device

configurations.name: RiverMind: Start Expo Go (Clear Cache)
configurations.command: source "${env:HOME}/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use --silent && pnpm exec expo start --clear
